source.authority: candidate-only; no physical provider admission, RCL promotion, release promotion or main-branch mutation

change.upstreamTerrainOwner: Large World Runtime terrain sampling and grid mesh
change.queryContract: sphere or upright capsule origin/direction/maxDistance -> bounded heightfield support-probe hit
change.algorithm: nine-point footprint support sampling over existing triangle-interpolated heightfield surfaces, deterministic fixed step traversal and binary refinement of first sampled contact

positiveEvidence: A fixed-point sphere cast against flat authored terrain returns the first support distance, point and upward normal.
An upright capsule cast uses its radius and half-height and returns the same deterministic support contact on flat terrain.
Unsupported box shape casts fail closed with SPATIAL_SHAPE_CAST_UNSUPPORTED rather than silently using an AABB approximation.
A lowered Large World terrain chunk reaches the same shape-probe path and returns a rooted terrain fixture hit.
negativeEvidence: This is a bounded support probe, not an exact swept sphere-vs-triangle or capsule-vs-triangle solver; fixed-step sampling is explicit and capped.
Only sphere and upright capsule probes are admitted; box, convex, heightfield query shapes, arbitrary capsule rotation and full contact manifolds remain open.
The probe does not change authoritative world state, integrate contacts, or replace the existing single-support collision solver.
No dynamic terrain, physical device, target GPU frame-rate, Android, external network or production terrain deployment evidence exists.
No K400 gate is promoted to PASS by source, package tests or CPU reference execution alone.
